name: Hibiki Shirokuro
source: A black and white dog that Ryoga has raised since puppyhood. With an excellent sense of smell and remarkable intelligence, Shirokuro often has her paws full due to Ryoga's terrible sense of direction, which frequently leaves him lost. Recently, Shirokuro gave birth to a litter of puppies.
translation: A black and white dog that Ryoga has raised since puppyhood. With an excellent sense of smell and remarkable intelligence, Shirokuro often has her paws full due to Ryoga's terrible sense of direction, which frequently leaves him lost. Recently, Shirokuro gave birth to a litter of puppies.
